10721|738b752e.name: Novice Warrior
10721|738b752e.text: Are you here to prove yourself as well?

10721|a05588c0.name: Novice Warrior
10721|a05588c0.text:
<Novice Warrior gulps.>

I can do this.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

1221-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1221-accept.text:
Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world!  But they're rare, very rare.  The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.

And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look!  That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me.  They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.

It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.
1221-accept.title: Blueleaf Tubers

1486-complete.name: Nalpak
1486-complete.text:
Your efforts shall not go unnoticed in gathering these hides, $N.

Thank you for your dedication.
1486-complete.title: Deviate Hides

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

1487-complete.name: Ebru
1487-complete.text:
As a Disciple of Naralex, I commend your bravery, $N.

Your aid in ridding the caverns is the first step in our long plight to see the Barrens restored.

Thank you and may you prosper.
1487-complete.title: Deviate Eradication

1491-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1491-complete.text:
Great, you got it!  I can't wait to try it out.  This is going to make me a fortune, I just know it!

Thank you, $N.  Take this, and after I'm rich I'll send you more, I promise!
1491-complete.title: Smart Drinks

748-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-accept.text:
Goblins and their servants have tainted our sacred water wells! We cannot allow this.

To cleanse each well, I must create a cleansing totem, then you must bring the totem to the well and perform a cleansing ritual.

First we will create a cleansing totem for the Winterhoof Water Well. To do this, the land must offer its aid. Hunt prairie wolves for their paws and adult plainstriders for their talons. They are to the southwest.

Return to me with the paws and talons, $N.
748-accept.title: Poison Water

761-accept.name: Harken Windtotem
761-accept.text:
The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt.  A collection of Swoop Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a hunter.

If you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop.

Bring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan.

The swoops may be found anywhere in Mulgore, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.
761-accept.title: Swoop Hunting

766-accept.name: Maur Raincaller
766-accept.text:
My grandfather told me stories about his battles with a strider named Mazzranache. He told me of its demonic red eyes, razor-sharp talons and venomous bite.

As fortune would have it, while traveling across the plains, I encountered it, and it took a nasty bite from my shoulder. He was as terrible as my grandfather described. I will need some hard-to-find animal parts to clean the infection from his bite: a wolf heart, cougar femur, plainstrider scale and swoop gizzard.

Hurry, time is of the essence.
766-accept.title: Mazzranache

767-complete.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
767-complete.text: I sensed you would be coming to me, $c. I can always recognize one who is trying to pass the Rites of the Earthmother.
767-complete.title: Rite of Vision

771-accept.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-accept.text:
In order to pass through the Rite of Vision, you must gather the reagents needed to make the Water of the Seers.

I will need well stones, which can be found around the water wells in Mulgore. With those I will combine Ambercorn, which fall beneath the mighty trees in our land.

These reagents contain magical elements, and when brewed and consumed before the tribal fire, will cause you to encounter a vision. Follow it, and it will lead you to the next step of this holy quest.
771-accept.title: Rite of Vision

894-accept.name: Sputtervalve
894-accept.text:
The Venture Company set up a small research facility far to the north of here, southwest of the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".

Now what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.

I obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
894-accept.title: Samophlange

92706-complete.name: Gazlowe
92706-complete.text:
Finally, somebody killed that thing! Do you know how hard it is to get a crew in the water when everyone in town's crying "Shark!" all the time?

I might just put that monster's fin into a soup for dinner tonight, just to have the last laugh.
92706-complete.title: WANTED: Bruuz

92706-progress.name: Gazlowe
92706-progress.text: What can I do for ya, $r?
92706-progress.title: WANTED: Bruuz

959-complete.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-complete.text:
Superb! And just as I was about to lose my job too! I will see to it that Gazlowe gets this gift immediately.

Thank you, $N. Nicely done, I say!
959-complete.title: Trouble at the Docks

959-progress.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-progress.text:
The dockmaster has been on my case ever since Mad Magglish made off with that 99-year-old port. I guess that bottle was intended as a gift for Gazlowe from none other than Baron Revilgaz himself.

If you're brave enough and patient enough to seek out Mad Magglish and get that port back, I'll see to it you get a nice reward.
959-progress.title: Trouble at the Docks

99108-accept.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-accept.text:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108-accept.title: Sparring Match
